e.title: 把「这个数是怎么来的」做成**每一行数据都要带的标签**：一份保险／精算案例研究仓库规定**每个观察值必须标注 `stated`／`calculated`／`estimated` 三者之一**，**并写明三者各自的规则**；**验证脚本会把不在三者之内的标签判为失败**，**且把两处对账容差的**理由**直接写在断言旁边**
e.title_en: Turning how a number came about into a label every data row must carry: an insurance and actuarial case-study repository requires each observation to be labelled stated, calculated or estimated, writes the rule for each, fails validation when a label falls outside those three, and puts the reason for two reconciliation tolerances directly beside the assertions
e.title_hk: 把「這個數是怎麼來的」做成**每一行數據都要帶的標籤**：一份保險／精算案例研究倉庫規定**每個觀察值必須標註 `stated`／`calculated`／`estimated` 三者之一**，**並寫明三者各自的規則**；**驗證腳本會把不在三者之內的標籤判為失敗**，**且把兩處對賬容差的**理由**直接寫在斷言旁邊**
e.summary: 一份**保险与精算的案例研究仓库**（★0、Python、**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-10——即在解冻窗口之内**）：**每个研究各自一个目录，含自己的数据、代码、测试与写作**，**可独立运行**；**其最值得记的一条是它为「数据的精度」立了规矩**——**逐字「每项研究都遵循同一纪律：**只用公开的一手来源**，**一份长表数据，其中**每一个观察值都带着自己的单位、出处 URL 与一个明确的精度标签（`stated`、`calculated` 或 `estimated`）**，**外加一份验证脚本与必须在任何图表发布之前通过的测试**」**；**而第二个值得记的是它**把一个数从哪一页抄下来的位置也做成了字段****（**其数据字典逐字写明「`source_section`：QRT、章节、页码、范围与／或计算说明，**足以把这个数字追回去**」**）**；**第三个是**验证脚本把标签规则变成了断言****（**逐字「当一处出处或对账检查失败时抛出断言错误」，**其中一条断言直接写明「非法的精度标签」**）**；**第四个是它**拒绝推断未公布的数字****（**逐字「该报告没有公布完整的去波动调整比率，**故不推断同业可比的上升幅度**」**）；**其当前唯一一项研究为**比利时五家最大保险集团的 FY2025 偿付能力 II 同业基准****（**⭐ 其最尖锐结论为** AXA 比利时报告的 215% 为 `stated`，**而去掉波动调整后为 147.6% 为 `calculated`，**差 67.4 个百分点**）
e.summary_hk: 一份**保險與精算的案例研究倉庫**（★0、Python、**創建與最後推送同為 2026-09-10——即在解凍窗口之內**）：**每個研究各自一個目錄，含自己的數據、代碼、測試與寫作**，**可獨立運行**；**其最值得記的一條是它為「數據的精度」立了規矩**——**逐字「每項研究都遵循同一紀律：**只用公開的一手來源**，**一份長表數據，其中**每一個觀察值都帶著自己的單位、出處 URL 與一個明確的精度標籤（`stated`、`calculated` 或 `estimated`）**，**外加一份驗證腳本與必須在任何圖表發布之前通過的測試**」**；**而第二個值得記的是它**把一個數從哪一頁抄下來的位置也做成了字段****（**其數據字典逐字寫明「`source_section`：QRT、章節、頁碼、範圍與／或計算說明，**足以把這個數字追回去**」**）**；**第三個是**驗證腳本把標籤規則變成了斷言****（**逐字「當一處出處或對賬檢查失敗時拋出斷言錯誤」**）；**第四個是它**拒絕推斷未公布的數字****（**逐字「該報告沒有公布完整的去波動調整比率，**故不推斷同業可比的上升幅度**」**）；**其當前唯一一項研究為**比利時五家最大保險集團的 FY2025 償付能力 II 同業基準****（**⭐ 其最尖銳結論為** AXA 比利時報告的 215% 為 `stated`，**而去掉波動調整後為 147.6% 為 `calculated`，**差 67.4 個百分點**）
e.summary_en: An insurance and actuarial repository of analytical case studies — 0 stars, Python, created and last pushed on the same day inside the thaw window — where each study gets its own folder with its own data, code, tests and write-up and can be run independently. **Its most notable feature is a rule it sets for how precise data may claim to be**: verbatim, every study follows the same discipline of public primary sources only, one long-format dataset in which each observation carries its own unit, provenance URL and an explicit precision label, plus a validation script and tests that must pass before any chart is published. **The second is that even where a number was copied from becomes a field**, the data dictionary stating verbatim that the source section records QRT, section, page, scope and calculation note sufficient to retrace the figure. **The third is that the validation script turns label rules into assertions**, raising an assertion error when a provenance or reconciliation check fails and including one for an invalid precision label. **The fourth is that it refuses to infer numbers that were never published**, verbatim declining to infer a peer-equivalent uplift because the report does not publish a full ratio without the volatility adjustment. Its single current study benchmarks the FY2025 Solvency II position of the five largest Belgian insurance groups, with its sharpest finding being a headline ratio stated at 215 percent that falls to 147.6 percent once the volatility adjustment is removed, a 67.4 percentage-point difference.
e.body:
**insurance-analytical-case-studies**（仓库 `ISHUKLA/casestudies`）**是一份保险、精算与金融数据的**自带分析案例研究**仓库**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NOASSERTION****（**⚠️ 其成因见下：`LICENSE` 文件**确实存在**，**但正文被追加了一段范围限定语**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 235 KB、**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-10**、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 创建与推送**都落在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 1,581 字节**；**仓库实测共 23 个条目（17 个文件、6 个目录）**（**经 codeload tarball 实测列出**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「标签：每个数都带着它的标签」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「标签」做成**机器可判定的规矩**做得最彻底的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README、数据字典、验证脚本与仓库文件清单实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它为「精度」立了三条规则，而且这三条规则讲的**不是小数位数，而是这个数是怎么来的****——**README 逐字为**：**「**Every study follows the same discipline: public primary sources only, one long-format dataset where each observation carries its own unit, provenance URL, and an explicit precision label (`stated`, `calculated`, or `estimated`), plus a validation script and tests that must pass before any chart is published.**」**；**而三条规则本身在数据字典里逐字给出**：**「**`stated`** — 按发布方**显示出来的精度**照录；**一个被四舍五入过的报告数字仍然算 `stated`**」「**`calculated`** — 用 `stated` 的观察值做算术，**并把公式写在 `source_section` 里**」「**`estimated`** — **因为发布方没有公布所要的拆解而必须做的明确映射或推断**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「被四舍五入过的报告数字仍然是 `stated`」****——**⭐ 本词条认为这一句把整套标签的意义讲清了：**标签记录的是**来源方式**（照录／算出来／推出来），**不是**精度高低****（**⭐ 与第 341 轮 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的「未知／尚未采集／不适用是三件事」、第 344 轮 [[insurek-swiss-deductible]] 的「数字与公式都在仓库里」同族，但这里多了一层：**三个标签各自有**判定规则****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **`calculated` 必须把公式写在出处字段里**——**⭐ 即**「算出来的」这个标签**自带算式**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **`estimated` 的定义直指「发布方没给」**，**并**点名实例**（**研究里某集团的 Tier 1 总额就是按这条规则映射到无限制 Tier 1 的**）**——**⭐ 即**推断被允许，**但必须**降级到 `estimated` 并说明理由****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **连「从哪一页抄的」都是字段，而且验证脚本会当场算一遍**——**其数据字典逐字写明九个列**（**`company`／`business_line`／`fiscal_year`／`metric`／`value`／`unit`／`precision`／`source_url`／`source_section`**）**，**其中 `source_section` 的定义逐字为**：**「**QRT、章节、页码、范围与／或计算说明，足以把这个数字追回去**」**；**实测其 CSV 为 **174 行**（**表头 1 行 ＋ 173 行观察值**），**每一行都带 `unit`、`precision`、`source_url` 与 `source_section`**（**示例行的出处逐字为 `QRT S.23.01.01 pp.65-66`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **出处细到**页码与范围**，而不是一个仓库级 URL**——**⭐ 与第 339 轮「每一个值都指回它的来源」相比，这一条**把「来源」细化到了**QRT 表号加页码****；**② ⭐⭐ **单位是逐行字段**（**`EUR_million`／`pct`／`percentage_points`／`boolean` 四种**）**——**⭐ 即**同一个数据集里百分比与百分点不会混****（**⭐ 本词条认为这一条**尤其值得做偿付能力比率的人记住**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **`company` 一列**承担了范围标签****（**逐字「在相关处，名称本身标明了单独口径还是合并口径」**）——**⭐ 即**solo／consolidated 的差别**写在实体名里****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **验证脚本把上面这些规则变成断言，且把两处容差的理由写在断言旁边**——**逐字为**：**「**当一处出处或对账检查失败时抛出断言错误**」**；**实测其 `scripts/validate_data.py` 至少含九条断言**：**列顺序与 schema 一致**、**必填格无空白**、**精度标签必须属于那三个词之一**（**原始信息为 `Invalid precision label`**）、**出处 URL 必须是 https**、**（公司，年，指标）不得重复**、**五家同业与两个年度都不得缺核心指标与分层指标**、**⭐ 用自有一资金除以 SCR 重算出的比率与所报比率之差必须 ≤ 0.6 个百分点**（**原始信息为「所报偿付能力比率未能在报告四舍五入容忍度内对账」**）、**⭐ 存储的同比变动与重算之差必须 ≤ 0.001**、**⭐ 四层自有一资金之和与总额之差必须 ≤ 2.0 百万欧元**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **标签规则**被写成了断言****（**⭐ 即**「不在三个词之内」**不是评审意见，**而是构建失败****）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **对账容差是一个**声明出来的数****（**0.6 个百分点／0.001／2.0 百万欧元**）**——**⭐ 而不是「大致对得上」**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其中最值得抄的一处是容差旁边的那句注释**：**其原始注释逐字为**「**KBC 与 Belfius 公布的是四舍五入到百万欧元的分层表，因而产生约 1 百万欧元的残差**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「为什么允许这个偏差」写得最短也最完整的一处**：**偏差、量级与成因同在一行****；**④ ⭐⭐ **重算方向是**从原始量算回比率****（**自有一资金 ÷ SCR × 100**）**——**⭐ 即**被检验的是**报告数字之间的关系**，而不只是格式****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它明确拒绝推断一个没有公布的数字**——**在逐家列出「标题比率藏住了什么」的那张表里，KBC 一栏逐字为**：**「**The SFCR includes a €103m VA own-funds component (`stated`) but does not publish a full no-VA ratio in the report, so no peer-equivalent uplift is inferred.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「故不推断同业可比的上升幅度」**——**⭐ 即**同一张表里别的同业给得出这个数，**这一家给不出，**于是**这一格就空着并说明为什么****（**⭐ 与第 336 轮「宁可拒绝，也不假装」、第 343 轮「无文档即不收」同一纪律，**但这次是在**一个单元格里**执行**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它同时把已有的那一半写上**（**该报告含 1.03 亿欧元的 VA 自有一资金成分，标注为 `stated`**）**——**⭐ 即**能说的说、不能说的说清为什么不能说**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其最尖锐结论本身就是一个标签对照**：**AXA 比利时的 **215%** 为 `stated`、**完全由 Tier 1 支撑**；**而去掉波动调整后为 **147.6%** 为 `calculated`，**即 **67.4 个百分点**为 `calculated`****——**⭐ 本词条认为这一组数把主题说透了：**同一个「偿付能力比率」，**一个照录、一个算出来，**两个标签之间**差 67.4 个百分点****。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **研究本身是**比利时五家最大保险集团的 FY2025 偿付能力 II 同业基准****（**2024 年保费收入口径＝Assuralia 的经济集团排名，逐字给出 AG 20.4%／AXA 12.0%／KBC 11.5%／Ethias 10.1%／Belfius 6.7%**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **它主动写明同业不可比**（**逐字「五家都同时经营寿险与非寿险，但它们的投资组合权重、法律范围、资本工具与 SCR 计算方法都不同，**故这个排名是一个起点而不是同口径的裁决**」**）**，**并把**每家所用的口径逐行标出**（**`AG Insurance SA/NV`／`AXA Belgium SA/NV`／`KBC Insurance NV, solo`／`Ethias SA, solo`／`Belfius Insurance, consolidated`**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它写明风控模块的数字不能相加**（**逐字「下列风险模块金额是分散化与损失吸收调整**之前**的总额或未分散金额；**它们不加总到 SCR 总额**」**）**；**④ ⭐⭐ **它给出一个外部参照线**（**比利时国家银行 2026 年金融稳定报告给出的混合型保险公司 FY2025 加权平均 SCR 比率为 **202%**，标注 `stated`**）**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其方法论一节写明**只有公开披露**，**并点名哪些东西看不到**（**逐字「分析只使用发行人托管的 SFCR 及其公开的 QRT 附件。**完整的监管 QRT 报送、RSR 与 ORSA 都留在监管机构手里，可能会改变上述解读。**」**）**；**⑥ **运行方式逐条给出**（**`python scripts/validate_data.py`、`python scripts/build_charts.py`、`pytest`**，**其中后者逐字说明「重新生成 README 里的每一张图」**）**；**⑦ **实测其目录结构为**根级 `LICENSE`／`README.md`／`.gitignore` ＋ `belgian-sfcr-peer-benchmark/` 一个研究目录**，**后者含 `charts/`（3 张 PNG）、`data/`（CSV ＋ `DATA_DICTIONARY.md` ＋ `SOURCES.md`）、`scripts/`（`validate_data.py`／`build_charts.py`）、`tests/test_data.py`、`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`requirements.txt`**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **可与本站条目并读**：[[sfcr-mistral-extraction]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[insurance-portfolio-performance]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **这是一处**新的 NOASSERTION 成因**，而且成因本身就是值得学的做法****——**实测其 `LICENSE` 文件**确实存在**（**raw 探测 HTTP 200**），**正文为标准 MIT 全文，**但末尾**追加了两句范围限定**（**逐字「**This license applies to repository code only. 裡**」「**`estimated`** — **因為發布方沒有公布所要的拆解而必須做的明確映射或推斷**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「被四捨五入過的報告數字仍然是 `stated`」**（標籤記錄的是**來源方式**（照錄／算出來／推出來），**而不是**精度高低）；**② ⭐⭐⭐`calculated` **連「從哪一頁抄的」都是字段，而且驗證腳本會當場算一遍**：**九個列逐字為 `company`／`business_line`／`fiscal_year`／`metric`／`value`／`unit`／`precision`／`source_url`／`source_section`**，**其中 `source_section` 的定義逐字為**「**QRT、章節、頁碼、範圍與／或計算說明，足以把這個數字追回去**」；**實測其 CSV 為 **174 行**（表頭 1 行 ＋ 173 行觀察值），每一行都帶 `unit`、`precision`、`source_url` 與 `source_section`**（示例行的出處逐字為 `QRT S.23.01.01 pp.65-66`）**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐出處細到**頁碼與範圍****（與第 339 輪「每一個值都指回它的來源」相比，這一條把來源細化到 **QRT 表號加頁碼**）；**② ⭐⭐單位是逐行字段**（`EUR_million`／`pct`／`percentage_points`／`boolean` 四種，即同一數據集裡百分比與百分點不會混）；**③ ⭐⭐`company` **insurance-analytical-case-studies** (repository `ISHUKLA/casestudies`) **is a repository of self-contained analytical case studies in insurance, actuarial work and financial data**. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NOASSERTION** — ⚠️ whose cause is given below, since the `LICENSE` file **does exist** but has a scope limitation appended to its text — **primary language Python, a 235 KB repository, created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-10, and no topics** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 1,581 bytes**; **the repository measures 23 entries, 17 files and 6 directories**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **labels, with every number carrying its own**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it makes labelling into a machine-decidable rule most thoroughly**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, data dictionary, validation script and file listing**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It sets three rules for precision, and those rules are about how a number came about rather than how many decimals it has** — the README states verbatim that every study follows the same discipline of public primary sources only, one long-format dataset where each observation carries its own unit, provenance URL and an explicit precision label, plus a validation script and tests that must pass before any chart is published; **and the three rules themselves appear verbatim in the data dictionary**: a stated value is transcribed from the cited document at the precision displayed by the publisher, **so that a rounded reported amount is still stated**; a calculated value is arithmetic using stated observations **with the formula described in the source section**; and an estimated value is **an explicit mapping or inference needed because the issuer did not publish the requested split** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a rounded reported amount still counting as stated makes the point of the whole scheme, since the label records how a number was obtained rather than how precise it is**, ⭐ **the same family as round 341’s three kinds of absence and round 344’s numbers and formula both living in the repository, though here each label carries its own rule**; ⭐⭐⭐ **a calculated value must carry its formula in the provenance field, so the label brings the arithmetic with it**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ the definition of estimated points straight at the issuer not having published the split, naming an instance in which one group’s total Tier 1 is mapped to unrestricted Tier 1, so inference is allowed but must be downgraded and explained**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Even where a number was copied from is a field, and the validation script recomputes on the spot** — the data dictionary lists nine columns verbatim, company, business line, fiscal year, metric, value, unit, precision, source URL and source section, **the last defined verbatim as the QRT, section, page, scope and calculation note sufficient to retrace the figure**; **the CSV measures 174 lines, a header plus 173 observations, every row carrying its unit, precision, source URL and source section**, an example row citing a specific QRT table and page range ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **provenance runs down to a page range rather than a repository-level URL**, ⭐ **refining round 339’s every value pointing back to its source into table number plus page**; ⭐⭐ **the unit is a per-row field drawn from four values, so percentages and percentage points cannot be confused in one dataset**; **and ⭐⭐ the company column carries the scope label, the dictionary stating that the name identifies solo versus consolidated scope where relevant**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The validation script turns those rules into assertions and puts the reason for two tolerances beside them** — verbatim, it raises an assertion error when a provenance or reconciliation check fails; **the script measurably contains at least nine assertions**: column order matching the schema, no blank required cells, **a precision label that must be one of those three words**, source URLs that must be https, no duplicate company-year-metric rows, complete core and tier metrics for all five peers in both years, ⭐ **a recomputed ratio from own funds divided by the SCR within 0.6 percentage points of the stated ratio**, ⭐ **a stored year-on-year change matching the recomputed difference within 0.001**, **and ⭐ tier sums within 2.0 million euro of eligible own funds** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the label rule becomes an assertion, so falling outside those three words is a build failure rather than a review comment**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the reconciliation tolerance is a declared number rather than an appeal to roughly matching**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the most copyable single item is the comment beside one tolerance, which states verbatim that two of the insurers publish rounded million-euro tier tables producing a residual of about one million euro, putting deviation, magnitude and cause on one line**; **and ⭐⭐ recomputation runs from the raw quantities back to the ratio, so what is checked is the relationship between reported numbers rather than only their format**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It explicitly refuses to infer a number that was never published** — in the table of what the headline ratios hide, one insurer’s row states verbatim that the report includes a large volatility-adjustment own-funds component labelled stated **but does not publish a full ratio without the volatility adjustment, so no peer-equivalent uplift is inferred** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **declining to infer the uplift leaves that one cell empty with a reason, while other peers in the same table can supply the number**, ⭐ **the same discipline as round 336’s rather refuse than pretend and round 343’s no documentation means no entry, here executed inside a single cell**; ⭐⭐ **it still records the half it does know, marking the disclosed component as stated**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ its sharpest finding is itself a contrast of labels, a headline ratio stated at 215 percent backed entirely by Tier 1 falling to 147.6 percent calculated once the volatility adjustment is removed, a difference of 67.4 percentage points that is itself calculated**, ⭐ **showing the theme plainly, since one and the same solvency ratio is transcribed in one place and computed in another with 67.4 percentage points between the two labels**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Other verifiable details**: **the study benchmarks the FY2025 Solvency II position of the five largest Belgian insurance groups by 2024 premium income using Assuralia’s economic-group ranking, with stated shares of 20.4, 12.0, 11.5, 10.1 and 6.7 percent**; **it states plainly that the peers are not comparable**, verbatim that all five write both Life and Non-Life while their portfolio weights, legal scopes, capital instruments and SCR calculation methods differ, **so the ranking is a starting point rather than a like-for-like verdict**, **and it labels each peer’s scope row by row**, from two named legal entities through two solo scopes to one consolidated scope; **its methodology section limits the analysis to public disclosure and names what cannot be seen**, verbatim that complete supervisory QRT submissions, the report to the supervisor and the own risk assessment remain with the supervisor **and could change the interpretation**;
